title: io.loams.dev.cost.adjustment.v1
description: The `data` of a `io.loams.dev.cost.adjustment.v1` event. The change to an allocation line already sent, after a recompute: `cost_micros` is new − sent. Design §84 §13.1.

cost_micros.description: The line's cost in micro-units of `currency` (10⁻⁶), split per pool-day by largest remainder so a pool-day's events sum to its cost rounded to micros. Negative for credits and adjustments

day.description: The UTC day the cost belongs to

engine.description: The engine, or idle, unattributed or shared

project.description: The namespace, `_` when it does not apply

query_class.description: The query class, `_` when it does not apply

usage.description: The driver quantity, a decimal with up to nine fractional digits

usage_unit.description: core_second, byte_second, byte, operation, device_second or none

report_digest.description: The digest of the inputs the line was computed from

cost_run.description: The cost job run (part of the event id)
